sloka: मनः सम्ह्लाद जननीम् वर्णस्य अपि प्रसादिनीम् ।ताम् शोक नाशिनीम् दिव्याम् श्रियः सम्जननीम् इव ॥५-९-२९॥
transliteration: manaḥ samhlāda jananīm varṇasya api prasādinīm ।tām śoka nāśinīm divyām śriyaḥ samjananīm iva ॥5-9-29॥

translations.english: (The mansion) was so full of effulgence and soul ravishing that it served as an adornment even to splendour. It looked as though it banished all sorrow and was a source of prosperity.
